definitions.explanation: Occurring or done at the same moment in time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can't do two things at the same time.

examples.japanese: {同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}めましょう→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's start at the same time.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{生|しょう}じた→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧。
examples.english: At the same time, problems also arose.

examples.japanese: {同時|どうじ}⟦{通訳|つうやく}→通訳：03516_tsuuyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧だ。
examples.english: Simultaneous interpretation is a difficult job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こなしている→こなす：09897_konasu⟧。
examples.english: He is managing work and studies at the same time.

notes:
{同時|どうじ} means at the same time or simultaneous.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {同時|どうじ}に (at the same time)
- ～と{同時|どうじ}に (at the same time as ~)
- {同時|どうじ}{通訳|つうやく} (simultaneous interpretation)
- {同時|どうじ}{進行|しんこう} (simultaneous progress)

GRAMMAR NOTE:
～と{同時|どうじ}に is often used as a conjunction meaning 'at the same time as' or 'while also.'
